A small update to **inkpainter3d** that makes it easy to tell us when something goes wrong.

**New**
• **Help → Report a bug…** opens a new GitHub issue with your description, the app version, your system and GPU, and optionally the last lines of the log already filled in
• **Crash reports:** if the app runs into an error, it saves a report and offers it on the next start: report it on GitHub, copy it, or leave it
• You see everything before it is sent, and reports hold no names, paths or images

**Fixed**
• Links in the app, for example in Help → About, now open in the browser

**Download** for Windows, Linux and macOS:
{release}

Bugs and feedback are welcome on GitHub: https://github.com/trueSilentisgold/inkpainter3d/issues
